_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
huskers: Husker football runs late August to late November at Memorial Stadium, seven home Saturdays sold out since 1962, with the Big Ten championship game and a bowl beyond that; the schedule is set the winter before.
huskersbasketball: Nebraska's men's season runs early November to March at Pinnacle Bank Arena, with the Big Ten tournament and the NCAA tournament beyond it; the non-conference slate fills in over the summer.
huskersvolleyball: Husker volleyball runs late August to late November at the Devaney Center, every match a sellout, with the NCAA tournament through mid December; the schedule lands in the spring.
stars: The Stars' USHL season runs late September to April at the Ice Box, 31 home dates, with the Clark Cup playoffs into May; the schedule arrives in July.
